issues.text: Existing tests I expect red after this work, by sub-step (the rows of section 10; read from their assertions, not run). B1: TX-11 (G5: AUTH_CODES is now 31 and the literal holds 23; also needs F2's eight auth_err texts). B2: MG-1 (G13, the table list 13 -> 17), MG-6 APP_GRANTS (G13), RLS-5 (G12), RLS-2 and RLS-3 (G12: tenantTables read from information_schema, the fixture() of rls.test.js has no projects and idea_versions rows); SEED-1 is green with the seed. B3, B4, B6: none (RL-5 stays green: its cleanup case has no stale invite). B5a: RT-1 (G3, and the allowed rateLimit list G1), SS-9 (G10), CS-1 (G9), PM-1 and PM-2 (G8), IS-4 and IS-5 (G6, G7), RA-5 (G2), RL-4 (G11). B5b: IS-1 and the other object-route cases (G6: the four tenant routes have no CASES yet). B5c: none new. B7: SI-1 (G19: the six rows name test files that do not exist yet). F-owned and later: PP-1, PP-2, PB-6, PP-7, the two CHANGED lists (G15, G16), FW-7 (green now on the files as they stand). I found no red test outside these rows. TXH-5 and the other tests with a planted tenant route stay green: a route without a plan runs the statements it ran before.

Signature of the plans. Design 4.5.2 gives planCreate(req); the plan needs the HMAC of keys.js for the project limit, which only the AuthContext holds, so planCreate is planCreate(ctx, req) and routes/projects.js wraps it as (req) => planCreate(ctx, req). planIdeaEdit(req) is as designed. Same reason, same file: services/orgs.js and services/projects.js hold a three-line keysOf of their own instead of importing it from http/auth-mw.js, because auth-mw.js imports PERSONAL_DATA_GATE from services/orgs.js (the design puts the constant there) and an import back would be a cycle.

docs/security-invariants.md: 4.10 and G19 say six rows (13 -> 19), each with one test name, and name eleven tests. I wrote six rows with one name each (TP-1, INV-6, RLS-6, INV-11, OO-1, BRD-3). The test-name rule of SI-1 (security-invariants.test.js: ^[A-Z]+(-[A-Z]+)*-\d+[a-z]?$) refuses M2R-1 (a digit in the prefix), so row 15 names INV-6 and not M2R-1; if TEST-DESIGNER wants M2R-1..M2R-3 in the table the rule needs a digit in the prefix. SI-1 is red until the six named tests exist.

Found by my own probe and fixed before this result: readAuditRows ordered by the bare name id, which in `select id::text as id … order by id` is the text output column (a string sort: ids 10-99 came before 9). It orders by audit_log.id now, as audit-store.js does. ADT-1 (rows in id order, paging reaches every row) is the test that catches it.

Small choices inside the design. readOpenDeletion stands in org-store.js and routes/auth.js imports it for `me` (4.6 names it in both stores): GET /api/auth/me now runs one more statement. The accepted name is stored as typed, as setup stores it. A new organisation's first member always gets org_owner (the creation refuses another role, and the accept does not read the invite's role for it). N1 answers its 404 as a returned refusal so the rate count commits. The lazy cleanup of stale invites also runs under tenant settings on a tenant route, where row-level security limits it to the caller's own organisation's invites (less, never more); RL-5 reaches it through a platform route as G11 says. The accept of an invite uses the same fixed-form 404 body as the other refusals: `{"error":"not_found"}`.

For TEST-DESIGNER. The invite code of N2 and N1 is the path parameter code (22 characters of base64url); a signed-in caller's cookie and CSRF token are checked on N2 (a stale token is csrf_refused), an anonymous one is not. N14 and N9 take {text, reason} strictly, so IS-1's body {} must be replaced by a valid body (F17). consent_langs is [ru, kk, en] on the test app and the consent digest per language comes from deps.auth.consentTexts when a test plants it (a missing kk value gives consent_stale). The tests can read the probes' expectations in <scratch>/m2proj-02b (p1-db.mjs, p2-routes.mjs, p3-more.mjs, p4-more.mjs, p5-plan.mjs).
